meta.name: frontend
meta.description: React/Redux frontend development patterns for RedisInsight UI: component folder structure, styled-components, hooks, named exports, barrel files, layout components, and theme usage. Use when editing any file under redisinsight/ui/**, writing or modifying React components, Redux slices, styled-components, custom hooks, or when the user mentions UI, frontend, React, Redux, or styled-components.

howto.what: 当你在 RedisInsight UI 项目中工作时，Claude 会遵循 React/Redux 开发规范：使用函数组件、hooks、命名导出、styled-components（而非 SCSS）、主题间距和语义颜色、Redux Toolkit 以及组件文件夹结构。
howto.when: 当你编辑 redisinsight/ui/ 下的文件、创建或修改 React 组件、Redux slice、styled-components、自定义 hooks，或提到 UI、React、Redux、styled-components 时。

say.text: 创建一个新的 React 组件，按项目规范搭建文件夹结构。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合规范的组件目录和文件。

say.text: 如何在 styled-components 中使用主题间距和语义颜色？
为这个列表写一个 Redux slice 和异步 thunk。

howto.what_en: When working on the RedisInsight UI project, Claude follows React/Redux development patterns: functional components with hooks, named exports, styled-components (instead of SCSS), theme spacing & semantic colors, Redux Toolkit, and component folder conventions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when editing files under redisinsight/ui/, creating/modifying React components, Redux slices, styled-components, custom hooks, or when you mention UI, React, Redux, styled-components.

say_en.text: Create a new React component with the project's folder structure.
say_en.note: Claude generates the component directory and files following conventions.
